local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 1:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(4589.0996,2871.937,-466),util.vector3(4726.0967,3079.6724,-438)}}
local step=1
local movingTime=0
local wasMoving=false
local locked=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on joined corridor')
 if frame==5 then
  local armor=0 local axe=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then armor=armor+1 end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then axe=true end
  end
  assert(armor==2 and axe,'Joined chest gear missing') print('Joined corridor ready')
 end
 local target,distance=nil,nil
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b541,0x3b52f}}) do
  local foe=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if foe and foe:isValid() and foe.enabled and not Actor.isDead(foe)
   and foe.cell and foe.cell.id==self.cell.id then
   local dist=(foe.position-self.position):length()
   if not distance or dist<distance then target,distance=foe,dist end
  end
 end
 if locked and locked:isValid() and locked.enabled and not Actor.isDead(locked)
  and locked.cell and locked.cell.id==self.cell.id
  and (locked.position-self.position):length()<=180 then
  target=locked distance=(locked.position-self.position):length()
 else locked=target end
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local mp=Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 if mp>=19 then print('Reinforcement magicka ready') end
 local fighting=target and distance<=350
 if step<=#points then
  local p=points[step]
  local delta=p-self.position
  if not fighting and math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)<(step==2 and 80 or 25) then
   print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1
  end
 end
 local goal=nil
 if fighting then goal=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,100)
 elseif step<=#points then local p=points[step] goal=util.vector3(p.x,p.y,self.position.z+100)
 else print('Reinforcement controlled approach complete') end
 if goal then
  local x,y,facing=aim(goal)
  print(string.format('Reinforcement controlled aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
  if facing then print('Reinforcement controlled facing') end
 else
  print('Reinforcement controlled aim x=0 y=0')
  print('Reinforcement controlled facing')
 end
 if fighting and distance<=150 then
  if hp<55 and mp>=19 then print('Reinforcement decision=heal')
  else print('Reinforcement decision=attack') end
 elseif step<=#points or fighting then print('Reinforcement decision=move')
 else print('Reinforcement decision=done') end
 local moving=self.controls.movement>0
 if moving then
  if not wasMoving then movingTime=0 end
  movingTime=movingTime+dt
  if movingTime>=(fighting and .25 or 1.5) or (fighting and distance<=150) or step>#points then print('Reinforcement controlled movement stop') end
 end
 wasMoving=moving
 if frame%15==0 then
  print('Joined corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b543,0x3b541,0x3b52f,0x3b52e}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Joined room actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 2:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local segment=0
local segmentTime=0
local wasMoving=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and hp>0,'Player died in joined Substructure')
 if frame==5 then print('Joined northern rat ready health='..hp) end
 if camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson then print('Substructure first person') end
 local rat=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b541))
 assert(rat and rat:isValid(),'Original zombie missing')
 local distance=(rat.position-self.position):length()
 local moving=self.controls.movement>0
 if moving then
  if not wasMoving then segment=segment+1 segmentTime=0 end
  segmentTime=segmentTime+dt
  if distance<=150 or Actor.isDead(rat) or segmentTime>=1.5 then print('Live approach segment '..segment..' stop distance='..distance) end
 elseif wasMoving then print('Live approach segment '..segment..' released') end
 wasMoving=moving

 if Actor.isDead(rat) then print('Joined northern rat dead') end
 if self.position.x>=600 or distance<=220 then print('Substructure first approach reached') end
 if distance<=150 or Actor.isDead(rat) then print('Joined northern rat in reach') end
 local x,y,f=aim(rat.position+util.vector3(0,0,100))
 print(string.format('Joined northern rat aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.2f',x,y,distance))
 if f then print('Joined northern rat facing') end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Joined northern rat Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..hp..' rat='..tostring(rat.position)) end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2}}
local n=1
local active=phases[n]()
local held=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if down and not held then n=n+1 assert(phases[n],'Unexpected west observation phase') active=phases[n]() print('West observation phase '..n..' ready') end
 held=down
 active.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt)
end}}}}
